name: The St. Regis. Shenzhen Bao An
positioning: St. Regis in Shenzhen's Bao'an District, officially The St. Regis Shenzhen Bao'an, with Andre Fu-designed rooms looking over the city or Qianhai Bay
best_for: Travelers who want a Bao'an District base about 20 km from Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport
Guests drawn to St. Regis rituals such as afternoon tea and the evening sabrage

facts.text: The hotel is at 1088 Xingye Road in Shenzhen's Bao'an District.
Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is about 20 km from the hotel.
The rooms and suites were designed by architect Andre Fu, pairing New York glamour with Shenzhen's energy.
Rooms feature dark oak parquet, dusty grey veneer and Carrara marble, with oriental-inspired timber screens and marquetry headboards.
Floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms frame views of the city or Qianhai Bay.
Yan Ting serves classic Cantonese dishes reimagined with modern artistry, led by Chinese Executive Chef Watson Chen.
The Drawing Room in the lobby serves afternoon tea every afternoon as a tribute to Caroline Astor.
The St. Regis evening ritual is performed in the Great Hall on the 35th floor every evening.
The evening ritual is a sabrage ceremony celebrating the transition from day to evening.
St. Regis Butler Service is offered at the hotel.
The hotel has one indoor pool.
Nearby attractions include OH Bay, Xiwan Mangrove Park, Nantou Ancient City and the Bay Opera of Shenzhen.

highlights.text: The St. Regis Bar's Bay Mary cocktail blends lychee and osmanthus as the hotel's twist on the St. Regis Bloody Mary.
At the center of The St. Regis Bar is a 4-meter-wide mural hand-painted by a local artist that tells stories of Bao'an.
The St. Regis Astor Terrace Bar is on an outdoor rooftop terrace with a cylindrical bar and views of the bay.
The Caroline Astor Suite is a bay-view suite with views of the bay, the Bay Glory Ferris wheel and the Bao'an coastal skyline.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle.
The St. Regis Spa is small, with four treatment rooms.
WhataHotel notes the Bao'an District location means travel to reach central Shenzhen attractions.
